name: Comic Fiesta
blurb: Southeast Asia's largest and longest-running ACG (anime, comics, games) convention, held every December in Kuala Lumpur since 2002.

editions.evidence: 2026 key-art image on the homepage (CF26_Announcement_v1-01.png) reads 'COMIC FIESTA 2026', dated '19.12 SAT — 20.12 SUN', location 'Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre'.

notes: Guests for Comic Fiesta 2026 are not announced yet: /guests-2026 404s (the site's sitemap only lists guests-2023, guests-2024 and guests-2025, one page per past edition), and the homepage's 'Our Events — Upcoming Events' section shows placeholder 'SOON!' tiles. The homepage's own 'Previously on Comic Fiesta' retrospective confirms the pattern of one December edition per year back to 2002 (most recently 2025: 20-21 Dec, Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre, 75,000 visitors), which is consistent with the 2026 key art. Organizer is the registered company from the Info page footer ('Comic Fiesta Sdn Bhd (1093656-D)').
